definitions.explanation: Rectangular pieces of pounded rice cake, typically sold in individually wrapped blocks. A staple food especially around New Year.

examples.japanese: {切り餅|きりもち}を{二|ふた}つ{入|い}れて{雑煮|ぞうに}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I made ozoni with two pieces of block mochi.

examples.japanese: お{正月|しょうがつ}が{近|ちか}づくと{切り餅|きりもち}がスーパーにたくさん{並|なら}ぶ。
examples.english: When New Year approaches, lots of block mochi are displayed at the supermarket.

notes:
Refers to mochi that has been pounded and cut into uniform rectangular blocks, as opposed to {丸餅|まるもち} (round mochi). {切り餅|きりもち} is the dominant form in eastern Japan, while {丸餅|まるもち} is traditional in western Japan. Commercially packaged {切り餅|きりもち} is a pantry staple that can be stored for months.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {切り餅|きりもち}を{焼|や}く: to toast/grill mochi
- {切り餅|きりもち}を{煮|に}る: to boil mochi
- {個包装|こほうそう}の{切り餅|きりもち}: individually wrapped block mochi

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {丸餅|まるもち}: round mochi — the round form traditional in western Japan
- {餅|もち}: rice cake — the general term for pounded rice cake in any shape
- {鏡餅|かがみもち}: mirror mochi — a decorative stacked mochi offering for New Year
